scope: Operational FIT HUB, FTL-branded (excluding Stride), and Anytime Fitness branches in DKI Jakarta; not all Jabodetabek.
notes: Opening hours follow the project owner instructions: FIT HUB weekday/weekend/holiday schedule; FTL and Anytime Fitness 24 hours.
Locations and operational status cross-checked against official brand directories; not on-site verification.
FTL coordinates use actual Google Maps venue pins linked by the operator when available, not viewport centers or repeated API placeholders.
Anytime Fitness uses its official global directory coordinates and Indonesian club list; administrative cities are normalized using the physical addresses.
Existing place IDs and all user favorites are preserved.
Presale/coming-soon and separate Stride-branded clubs are excluded from the active catalog.
